## Children (2026-10-15T08:04Z)

Dispatch order follows the dependency lines on the cards: the shell and the two shared pieces first, then the pillars.

**Shell and shared pieces**
- [ ] #12447 — shell header: three-column grid, app chip, centered pillar switcher, Changes pill + Publish, shared type scale
- [ ] #12448 — shared 240 px pillar rail (depended on by #12450, #12454, #12455, #12456)
- [ ] #12449 — shared 300 px inspector aside (depended on by #12450, #12451, #12454, #12455, #12456)
- [ ] #12453 — read-only posture: two signals (after #12447)

**Pillars**
- [ ] #12450 — Data: object header in the content column, seven flat tabs, toolbar and grid without nested containers (after #12448, #12449; carries open decision B)
- [ ] #12451 — Data Form tab: toolbar, section and field cards (after #12449, #12450)
- [ ] #12454 — Automations: rail grouped by trigger object, header switch and meta, tabs (after #12448, #12449)
- [ ] #12455 — Interfaces: navigation tree rail, ten-kind picker, canvas per kind (after #12448, #12449)
- [ ] #12456 — Access: permission-set header, five tabs, matrix restyle (after #12448, #12449; carries open decision C)

**Held on a maintainer decision (see Open decisions above)**
- [ ] #12452 — Access in the pillar nav, More retired (decision A)

Follow-up outside this subtree: the objectstack console pin bump once the last child lands.
